historical.title: VNCoffeePrice: A Multi-Source Dataset for Robusta Coffee Price Forecasting in Vietnam (2020–2026)
historical.transformation: Only date, province and domestic coffee_price_vnd_kg retained; province IDs normalized. All 5,445 values verified against raw train/val/test domestic files. No interpolation, averaging, or forward/backward filling.
limitations: The publisher does not establish official-statistics-grade provenance for the original domestic coffee price series; independently verify before relying on it.
Dates are irregular and coverage differs by region. Dak Nong and Kon Tum stop on 2026-01-16; the other three end on 2026-05-22.
Exogenous fields in the upstream merged dataset were forward/backward filled; these fields are excluded here. Domestic prices were not filled by the build script.
The archive README contains a provisional license note and an older DOI; the public version-3 landing page explicitly declares CC BY 4.0 and DOI 10.17632/p8fhcw59b7.3.

limitations: One public snapshot only; no permission or service agreement for ongoing republication has been established.
The first linked historical page returned HTTP 403; collection stopped without bypass. No recent daily history is available.
Quoted reference prices may differ from actual local transactions. Fetch time and source observation date are distinct.

methodology.seasonality: For one region and one historical source, use only calendar years with observations in all 12 months. Compute each monthly observed-price mean, divide by the equal-month annual mean, subtract 1, and average percentage deviations across eligible years. This describes historical patterns, not a price forecast or trading recommendation.
